history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A 3D anime girl with long, dark hair, large brown eyes, and fair skin stands in the center, wearing a white off-the-shoulder crop top with ruffled sleeves and a black polka-dot mini skirt. Her arms are crossed, and she has a neutral expression. The background is a collage of framed anime-style illustrations of the same girl in various poses, all with a sepia tone and simple decorative elements like hearts, stars, and clouds. Some of the framed illustrations show her winking and making a peace sign, resting her chin on her hand, hugging a teddy bear, and posing thoughtfully. In the bottom right corner, there's a small circular inset of a real-life photo of the girl in the same outfit. The overall aesthetic is cute, playful, and reminiscent of a scrapbook or mood board. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a gentle glow around the central figure and the illustrations. The color palette is dominated by sepia tones, black, white, and the soft peach of the girl's skin and pants. The mood is lighthearted and charming.
